ideas.pitch: A meta-prompting interface where users write a single complex master prompt to automatically scaffold, style, and deploy a working multi-page web application instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: THEME REVEAL: Prompt Competition Unlike Any Other - building a working application powered entirely by prompts.
ideas.title: PromptSynth AI Application Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core hackathon mandate of going beyond standard chatbots to construct functional software entirely through advanced prompting techniques.

ideas.pitch: An AI logic puzzle and rule-checking environment where users program logical rulebooks via natural language prompts to generate interactive constraint-solving games.
ideas.problem_statement: THEME REVEAL: Prompt Competition Unlike Any Other - involves AI, creativity, logic, and a whole lot of imagination.
ideas.title: LogicCraft Meta-Logic Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans heavily into the 'logic and imagination' hint in the prompt, showcasing structured reasoning generated purely from prompt execution.

ideas.pitch: An interactive storytelling and branching-logic app whose entire backend database schema, user interface state, and character dialogues are dynamically written and governed by active prompt chains.
ideas.problem_statement: THEME REVEAL: Prompt Competition Unlike Any Other - creating something entirely new with prompts beyond a chatbot conversation.
ideas.title: MythosForge Narrative Application
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear creative output and a fully working application loop rather than just static text generation.

ideas.pitch: A runtime dashboard generator where users input high-level analytical prompts to instantly instantiate custom data visualization widgets, filtering pipelines, and working UI layouts.
ideas.problem_statement: THEME REVEAL: Prompt Competition Unlike Any Other - building your own working application powered entirely by prompts.
ideas.title: PromptUI Dashboard Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a tangible, highly visual live demo that proves prompt-driven software can replace traditional component building.

ideas.pitch: A visual canvas where users drop prompt blocks that act as autonomous micro-services, chaining together to form working multi-step business logic applications without writing manual code.
ideas.problem_statement: THEME REVEAL: Prompt Competition Unlike Any Other - challenge to go beyond writing a prompt to creating working applications.
ideas.title: PromptFlow Workflow Architect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the architectural challenge of orchestration through prompting, aligning with judges looking for robust, working software deliverables.
